content:
**Dunmer** 家具套装出自 [**Fantasy's Furniture**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fantasy-furniture)，添加了功能完整的家具，包括但不限于：**箱子**、**抽屉**、**床铺**、**座椅**等！ 该家具套装的设计深受**上古卷轴**系列中**Dunmer**种族的启发，尤其是其在**《晨风》**与**《上古卷轴Online》**中的外观。
合成**Dunmer 木板**/**Dunmer 羊毛**时，需将 **#minecraft:planks**/**#minecraft:wool** 作为输入材料。 ![Dunmer木板-切石机](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_dunmer/stonecutter_planks.png) ![Dunmer羊毛-切石机](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_dunmer/stonecutter_wool.png) 合成**Dunmer** 家具方块时，需将 **#fantasyfurniture:binding_agent**、**Dunmer 木板** 和 **Dunmer 羊毛** 放入 **Furniture Station**。 ![家具工作台](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_dunmer/furniture_station.png)
